title: TF_DENORMALIZED_QUATERNION and TF_NAN_INPUT "Ignoring transform for child_frame_id" in ROS 2: zero quaternions, NaN, unnormalized rotations and Lyrical's stricter check, measured
excerpt: On Humble and Jazzy a zero quaternion printed both errors and the frame vanished, while unnormalized rotations were silently normalized. Lyrical rejected any quaternion with |q|^2 more than about 0.01 from 1. The listener prints it, not the publisher. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
